objective.title: Record the Service Anomaly
objective.description: Capture the affected EuroSat service, the observed onset, and Ola's workload symptoms. Keep the first report and sample times so later evidence can be compared with the same event. The EuroSat interruptions recur (about every 100 s, down for 35 to 40 s), so press Check on the registration layer until it reads Down.

conditions.description: Affected service, onset and symptoms recorded

condition.description: Affected service, onset and symptoms recorded

objective.title: Review the Available Evidence
objective.description: Compare the physical checks, provider status, and service observations around the anomaly. Record checks that rule out a local explanation as well as evidence that remains inconclusive. The interruptions recur about every 100 s and last 35 to 40 s, so press Check on the EuroSat registration layer again until it reads Down.

objective.title: State the Incident Confidence
objective.description: Decide whether the collected evidence supports suspected interference or an unexplained outage. Name the observations supporting that assessment and keep source attribution unresolved.

conditions.description: Assessment filed on EuroSat with the readings that support it

params.question: A service record supports suspected interference but contains no source-location evidence. Which statement belongs in the incident report?
options: The interference source is confirmed because the service changed.
The nearest known transmitter caused the observed interruption.
The provider is responsible because its terminal was affected.
Interference is suspected; the source remains unestablished.
params.explanation: Evidence of a service anomaly can support a suspected mechanism without locating its source. The report should preserve that distinction so the later investigation starts from observations rather than an unsupported attribution.

objective.title: Preserve the Incident Record
objective.description: Save the relevant observations, configuration history, and confidence statement together. Retain original timestamps and identify any gaps in the record. Both terminals are still drawing on the battery, so check the forecast on the power planning sheet before the hour is out.

objective.description: Choose only a workload supported by the remaining connection and resource allowance. Apply the permitted configuration, then verify the task with a fresh end-to-end result.
